mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 48 degrees with overcast skies at Harriet Park and a waning crescent moon visible in the night sky.

The City of Verona is reminding residents to subscribe to their digital newsletter for updates on local projects, while also noting that upcoming asphalt repair work is scheduled for November 9 and 10 on Nine Mound Road and surrounding areas.
We have a busy schedule ahead, with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today, Hop Haus trivia on Thursday, and the Dane County Farmers' Market on Saturday.
On October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for an O W I after he was found unresponsive in his vehicle.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry, and our local Culver's team will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
